entries.mitigation: Cleanse the splinter DoT deliberately: use Galvanizing Blow, bait Galvanic Charge, or reach a Rupture threshold. Do not simply heal through accumulating splinters.
Priority kill. Block its heavy because the hit chains lightning around the target.
Read whether the side or center atronachs activate and move immediately to the safe floor.
Remember where the crystal hazards are after the red telegraph fades; preserve a clean Rupture flight lane.
Tank the boss near an edge and face the T-shaped cluster pattern away from the arena center.
Have the healer bait furthest. Stack the shard adds into the beam and have the tank help share beam damage.

entries.entry_name: Black Gem Shards — Black Gem Monstrosity
entries.mitigation: Stack tightly before the shard spawn, place the small AOEs together, then line the Soul Focus beam through the shards instead of trying to brute-force them with player damage.

entries.entry_name: Black Gem Barrage — Black Gem Monstrosity
entries.mitigation: Marked player keeps moving and leaves a clean trail. Do not double back through dropped gem AOEs.
Move out of your personal slam AOE promptly so you do not create unnecessary Soul Essences; then react to red, yellow, and green essence behavior correctly.
Hard swap to the spawned souls and kill them before the target circle fills, then repeat on the second target.

entries.entry_name: Refraction Color Puzzle — High Soulbinder Vykand
entries.mitigation: Reveal the refractions, read the two colors shown by Vykand, then each player takes the third color. Wrong color is lethal.
Drag each small soul to its matching colored crystal before killing it or you create extra Soul Essence pressure.
Big adds are priority. Tank controls them; heal through the ranged add's heal-absorb effect while DDs remove it quickly.
